scope: Internal owned prepare/transfer/joined-close engine only. No JSON-RPC/Tauri Apply, actual HID, daemon launch or native GUI execution.
implementation: Scope check before seal; owned job holds cancel sender independently of client lifetime. Status/progress watches and completion receiver; dropping client does not abort worker.

Maintenance -> serialized handoff -> staging close -> checked all-device keeper/save join -> checked drain -> fresh target/peer settings and named Screen asset ownership -> arm -> original actor transfer -> joined close.
Refuses remaining publication scopes/temporaries or malformed histories; no publication reconciliation silently performed during firmware snapshot.
Image/media pins and font bytes retained through transport/root teardown. Budget2048distinct refs,64MiBfonts. No encoder/render subprocess.

Coordinator arm opts into fresh snapshot binding: compare at arm and under settings state gate before guard/effects marker/hold after identity query. Changed intent is preserved and refuses marker. Lower-level synthetic fixtures retain caller-snapshot semantics.

Drain deadline30s refuses transfer while continuing to join existing work; does not abandon blocking jobs. Cancellation noticed in prepare gives NotStarted without arm; later cancellation before hold may persist NotStarted journal, after hold stays Unknown.
No retry/rollback/reopen/restore/quarantine clearing. Terminal AwaitingReconnect requires joined root close and is not success. Lost transfer reply/failed close do not become success.

cancel after pump hold Unknown/guard and zero chunks
